title: forsage ethereum smart contract explained for beginners
description:
This video explains what the forsage ethereum smart contract is and how it works.
This is the Forsage Ethereum Smart Contract on Etherscan: https://etherscan.io/address/0x5acc84a3e955Bdd76467d3348077d003f00fFB97

Philippines SEC warns Forsage is an illegal investment scheme https://lnkw.co/Forsage-SEC-Warning

The SEC warns... "A maximum fine of P5 million or imprisonment of 21 years or both await those who act as salesmen, brokers, dealers or agents of entities engaged in unauthorized investment schemes, for violation of Republic Act No. 8799, or The Securities Regulation Code Securities Regulation Code, among others. "

If you found this video useful, please subscribe, give me thumbs and up comment.Thanks for watching.

https://www.PaulHardingham.com

That's what I want to do on this short video is just show you that. Now I'm in an account here which you can view any of these accounts, part of the beauty of Ethereum and blockchain is that it's all transparent. What you don't know is who owns this account, this one, one, four, eight, one, one. I have an idea because someone has done a YouTube video, so it could be their account or it might not be their account. But they've referred 60 people and they've got $155,000 worth of earnings so far. So very, very attractive. Lots of people doing YouTube videos saying how much they're earning. But one thing you do need to be aware of, just before I show you how the smart contract works and what that's all about, Forsage is a classic pyramid scheme. There's absolutely no doubt about that. It doesn't generate any income from any other source other than recruiting other investors Those investors, their money is paid to earlier investors. So it's the classic robbing Peter to pay Paul. It is an illegal scheme. But there's a lot of people don't seem to have any issues with that. But do bear that in mind, if you decide to get involved, you are 90% likely, maybe even more to lose your money, and it is an illegal pyramid scheme so if you're promoting it then you are actually breaking the law anywhere in the world as well. That aside let's have a look because having said that it is very very clever in terms of how it works. If we scroll to the bottom of the page on Forsage, you will see that there is a smart contract address. And if you click on to Ethereumscan, Ethereumscan is the site is the blockchain explorer for Ethereum. So Ethereumscan allows you to scan all the transactions all the smart contracts, everything that happens with Ethereum. And on this page here, so we're now on the smart contract page for Etherscan Forsage, if you come down the page right here you see the tab here which says contract, if you click on that you can actually come through and see the full details of the contract. you can see the source code, the actual source code for the Forsage ethereum contract. And the whole point of an ethereum contract is that it is unchanged,able and by being called a smart contract let's give a quick example of how this works. Let's say I wanted to encourage a builder to do some work on my house and he knows that if he meets certain criteria, when he repairs the wall or whatever it is I ask him to do then he knows he's guaranteed to get paid money. If we had a smart contract between the two of us he could see that as long as he completed the work and completed the input that was required on the smart contract the smart contract would automatically pay him the amount based on the work that's there so and this smart contract like I said cannot be changed so it's a very very clever piece of technology and that's why a Ethereum is such an interesting cryptocurrency and that's what happens with for sageage so for Fossage very simply like i've said someone pays to join for sage that money gets paid to their sponsor gets distributed through the network and so on and essentially in a very classic simple pyramid scheme but it's all based on this uh cleverly designed smart contract now they didn't design rather they designed the contract but ethereum um the guy who created ethereum who was the guy who came up with the idea of the smart contracts tied-in with ethereum so that's the background for it like I've said please bear in mind that Forsage is a pyramid scheme so if you are going to get involved just make sure you're fully aware of that before you get involved because you're most likely going to lose your money but if you'd like some more videos explaining uh things like 4SARGE and Smart contracts give me a thumbs up pass some comments let me know what you'd like me to do some videos on really appreciate that and if I get enough thumbs up then obviously I'm on the right track and we'll produce more videos just like this I wish you all the best and thanks for watching

textual.limitations: The source does not independently verify the account ownership, referral count, earnings amount, or whether the earnings were actually received.

textual.observation: The speaker states that joining Forsage requires payment and that the payment is distributed to the sponsor and through the network.

evidence.quote: someone pays to join for sage that money gets paid to their sponsor gets distributed through the network and so on

textual.context: Presented as an explanation of how the described smart contract operates, not as a clear invitation to participate.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish the actual transaction terms, amounts, participants, or whether the described flow occurs in a specific transaction.
